Fixes the multiplayer launchers in v0.3.6.

- Multiplayer.cmd and `sh Multiplayer.sh` now start from a normal installation. In v0.3.6 they stopped with a message about portable.txt, left over from the multiplayer beta. The Windows launcher now writes its logs to the game's data folder (%APPDATA%\TenchuZRecomp, or `user` beside the game for a portable install) and shows where.
- The multiplayer guide and report form are now for the regular release: see the [multiplayer guide](https://github.com/8bitninja64/TenchuZ-PC/blob/v0.3.7/docs/multiplayer-guide.md). The separate beta download is retired. Everyone in a session needs v0.3.7.
- If you created an empty portable.txt to get around the v0.3.6 message, you can delete it: the game then returns to your normal saves.

Everything from v0.3.6 is included: lower CPU load while waiting for the GPU, anti-aliasing Off, and fullscreen with vsync off no longer held to the display's refresh rate.

Updating: use the in-game updater, or close the game and extract the package over your existing installation, keeping your saves and settings. The game code does not need to be prepared again when updating from v0.3.6. The Linux package targets glibc 2.35 for Ubuntu 22.04 and newer, including SteamOS.

Known reports still under investigation: overbright training floors on some AMD GPUs, and reports of lower image quality since v0.3.5 that do not reproduce here yet. No game data is included.
